children: G-III Apparel Group finalized a suite of agreements supporting its Marc Jacobs strategy. The company obtained a long-term license from IPCo to operate Marc Jacobs retail and e-commerce and distribute key product categories across the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Western Europe. In parallel, G-III and WHP established 50/50 ownership and governance for IPCo through an amended operating agreement with joint approval rights over major actions. To ensure a smooth handover, LVMH and third-party providers will supply transition services to Marc Jacobs International, with G-III guaranteeing related obligations.
Agreement 1: G-III Apparel Group Enters Transition Services Pact With LVMH to Support Marc Jacobs Integration
: Ensure seamless post-closing transition and continuity
Agreement 2: G-III Apparel Group Secures Long-Term License to Operate Marc Jacobs Across North America and Western Europe
: Initial term to Dec 2041; ten 5-year renewals
: Expand and operate Marc Jacobs brand in key markets
Agreement 3: G-III Apparel Group and WHP Establish 50/50 Governance for IPCo Under Amended Operating Agreement
: Define joint control and governance of Marc Jacobs IP
